headword: {家庭用|かていよう}ゲーム{機|き}

definitions.explanation: A dedicated video-game machine designed to be connected to a television or monitor at home, as opposed to handheld systems, smartphones, arcade cabinets, or PCs. The standard industry term in Japanese for products such as PlayStation, Nintendo Switch (in dock mode), and Xbox.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{家庭用|かていよう}ゲーム{機|き}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a new home game console.

examples.japanese: {家庭用|かていよう}ゲーム{機|き}{市場|しじょう}は{年々|ねんねん}{拡大|かくだい}している。
examples.english: The home console market is expanding every year.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}、{初|はじ}めての{家庭用|かていよう}ゲーム{機|き}にすっかり{夢中|むちゅう}になった。
examples.english: As a child, I became completely absorbed in my first home game console.

examples.japanese: スマートフォンの{普及|ふきゅう}により、{家庭用|かていよう}ゲーム{機|き}{離|ばな}れが{進|すす}んでいると{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that the spread of smartphones has accelerated the move away from home game consoles.

notes:
Composed of {家庭|かてい} (home; household), {用|よう} (for the use of), the loanword ゲーム (game), and the suffix {機|き} (machine). The structure parallels other 'for-home-use' product names such as {家庭用|かていよう}プリンター (home printer).

USAGE:
A standard industry and journalistic term for TV-connected game consoles, contrasting with {携帯|けいたい}ゲーム{機|き} (handheld console) and アーケードゲーム (arcade game). In casual conversation people more often refer to specific brands (PS5, Switch) or simply say ゲーム{機|き}. The full form {家庭用|かていよう}ゲーム{機|き} is preferred in industry reports, sales figures, and trade press. Sometimes shortened to {据|す}え{置|お}き{機|き} ('stationary console') in gamer slang.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {家庭用|かていよう}ゲーム{機|き}{市場|しじょう}: the home console market
- {家庭用|かていよう}ゲーム{機|き}ソフト: home console software
- {次世代|じせだい}{家庭用|かていよう}ゲーム{機|き}: next-generation home console
- {家庭用|かていよう}ゲーム{機|き}{本体|ほんたい}: console hardware itself (as opposed to peripherals)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {携帯|けいたい}ゲーム{機|き}: handheld game console — the portable counterpart
- {据|す}え{置|お}き{機|き}: stationary machine — gamer slang for home console
- ゲーム{機|き}: game machine — broader, includes handhelds and arcade machines
- ゲーミングPC: gaming PC — the personal-computer alternative
